Use case: ui-mockup. Edit the supplied A02 game upgrade-menu mockup into a polished revision. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, not just loose inspiration. Preserve its appealing illustrated anime science-fiction game style: dark navy tactical glass, restrained cyan and silver frames, readable condensed white type, illustrated rifle/turret/Burst row art, Snow White portrait, thin hexagon rails, and a dim paused battlefield visible around the inset overlay. This is a full game-screen screenshot, not a browser page. The menu takes most but not all of the screen, with no scrolling.

Change the progression presentation to five ranks PLUS a separately named automatic CAPSTONE endpoint. Three horizontal ability rows, each containing exactly six linked positions: Rank 1, Rank 2, Rank 3, Rank 4, Rank 5, Capstone. All future upgrades must remain visible. Compact the illustrated left row panels to make room for the sixth column; preserve the quality of their weapon/turret/Burst art. Do not add branches, tabs hiding abilities, or separate buying buttons at every node. Give capstones distinct elegant gold-framed hexagonal medallions with a small crown motif and restrained gold treatment even while locked. They must feel like major rewards, not ordinary ranks. A thin gold connector joins Rank 5 to its capstone. Keep rank icons recognizably different, simple and readable.

Exact shared top headings: "ABILITY RANKS"; "SNOW WHITE  |  LV 14  |  4 SP"; "PAUSED".
Exact six column headers on two lines:
"RANK 1" / "BASE"
"RANK 2" / "1 SP"
"RANK 3" / "2 SP"
"RANK 4" / "3 SP"
"RANK 5" / "4 SP"
"CAPSTONE" / "AUTO · FREE"
These costs are individual next-rank costs, not cumulative.

Exact row labels and node names:
WEAPON: "Seven Dwarves", "Marked Rounds", "Afterburn", "Burning + Slow", "Charging", "Unyielding".
SPECIAL: "Auto-Turret", "Expanded Arsenal", "Defensive Line", "Incendiary Arsenal", "Permanent Emplacement", "Detonation".
BURST: "Seven Dwarves", "Fully Active", "Focused Fire", "Pierce + Stun", "A Century of Prep Time", "A Goddess Who Cannot Yield".
Wrap long names cleanly to two or three lines; do not abbreviate the capstone names or change spelling.

"UNYIELDING"

Keep the structure clean and deliberate, no giant empty bands, no tiny illegible paragraphs, no tooltip obscuring the roadmap, no extra popups, no random decorative data, no web navigation, no phones or portraits.
